cards.title: Comparing two variables
cards.body: A condition can compare two variables, not just a variable and a number.

cards.title: >= includes equal
cards.body: `>=` means greater than or equal, so it is True when both values are the same. That is handy for ties.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: 6 > 6 is False, so the else branch prints b, which is also 6.
